screen: SEASON STATS — PASSING, scope NATIONAL, sorted by YARDS descending
method: Nineteen columns across two recordings. IMG_5208 carries GP through TD:INT, IMG_5209 from YPA to SNAPS; both keep the NAME column, so they merge by name and all 192 matched in order.
validation: Eight identities hold on all 192 rows. Within the first screen: COMP% is floor(100*COMP/ATT), TD% and INT% are per attempt, and TD:INT is the ratio. Across the two screens: YPA is yards per attempt, YPG yards per game, SACK% is sacks over attempts plus sacks, and RATING reproduces the NCAA formula (8.4*yards + 330*TD + 100*completions - 200*INT) / attempts. Two ratings sit exactly on a tenth (W.Wilson 99.2, D.Afalava 142.8) and the game prints one tenth lower, which is its own single-precision truncation rather than a misreading.
teams: No team column. Beyond the two identified in the earlier pass, three are now certain: B.Lowry's line matches Western Michigan's team passing totals exactly on attempts, yards, touchdowns and interceptions, and N.Kim and A.Flores leave only 8 and 4 attempts respectively for Eastern's and Central's backups.
list_length: 192 quarterbacks, every player who attempted a pass, down to T.Ulatowski at 0 for 1.
